title: Midnight Memories
headline: Harry Styles teased Midnight Memories with alphabet cards
caption:
Midnight Memories, One Direction's third album, came out 13 years ago today, and the band teased more than just its title.

On 11 October 2013 they shared the track list as a Twitter quiz under #MidnightMemoriesTrackQuiz, a mix of hints and blank spaces to fill in, along with the final answer. The cover got out early too. The Sun posted it first, though only members of the paper's online version could see it, and the band's own Twitter account then confirmed it was the real artwork. The album itself leaked a week before release.

Louis Tomlinson had promised a "rockier" sound than before. USA Today's Brian Mansfield singled out the "riffy title track".

🎧 Key track: "Midnight Memories" by One Direction (@onedirection)
